identity.name: Park.in
identity.core_philosophy: Jaipur's heritage meets modern utility. Warm sandstone tones mixed with electric functionality.

secondary.name: Peacock Teal
secondary.usage: Secondary Actions, Success States, Map Markers

grids.bento_locations: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6 auto-rows-[300px]

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 h-12 px-8 rounded-full font-bold shadow-lg hover:shadow-xl transition-all hover:-translate-y-0.5
buttons.secondary: bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground hover:bg-secondary/90 h-12 px-8 rounded-full font-bold shadow-md hover:shadow-lg transition-all
buttons.outline: border-2 border-primary text-primary hover:bg-primary/10 h-12 px-8 rounded-full font-bold transition-all

cards.location_card: group relative overflow-hidden rounded-2xl bg-white shadow-md hover:shadow-2xl transition-all duration-300 border border-border/50
cards.booking_summary: bg-white rounded-xl p-8 shadow-lg border-t-4 border-primary

inputs.default: h-12 rounded-lg border-2 border-input bg-white px-4 focus:border-primary focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/20 transition-all

parking_slot.base: aspect-[2/3] rounded-md border-2 flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-sm transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-sm
parking_slot.selected: bg-blue-600 border-blue-600 text-white shadow-lg scale-110 ring-4 ring-blue-200

textures.noise: opacity-20 mix-blend-overlay pointer-events-none fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-[url('https://grainy-gradients.vercel.app/noise.svg')]

setup: Update /app/frontend/src/index.css with the CSS variables provided in colors.css_vars_override.
Install 'react-leaflet' and 'leaflet' for the map functionality.
Install 'clsx' and 'tailwind-merge' for class utility if not present.
layout_rules: Use the 'Bento' grid for the Location Selection page.
Ensure the Parking Slot Selection page is mobile-responsive. On mobile, the map should be sticky or easily toggleable.
Use the 'Warm Sandstone' background for all pages to maintain the Jaipur vibe. Do not use pure white backgrounds for full pages.
component_rules: For the Parking Slot grid, use CSS Grid. Do not use absolute positioning for slots unless using a canvas-based approach (which is overkill here).
Use Shadcn UI components for the Date Picker, Dialogs, and Dropdowns, but style them using the 'surface' and 'primary' colors.
The 'Book Now' button must be the most prominent element on the screen.
accessibility: Ensure contrast ratios between the Orange primary and White text are sufficient. If not, use black text on orange or darken the orange.
All parking slots must have aria-labels indicating their status (e.g., 'Slot A1, Occupied').

universal_guidelines: Use 2-3x more spacing than typical designs.
